name: agent-passport-pro
description: Stop AI agents from taking irreversible actions nobody authorized: identity, policy, argument-bound approval, Spend Firewall and red-team harness

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agent-passport/core && npm run build -w @agent-passport/telemetry && npm run build -w @agent-passport/adapters && npm run build -w @agent-passport/payments && npm run build -w @agent-passport/cli && npm run build -w @agent-passport/mcp-proxy && npm run build -w @agent-passport/http && npm run build -w agent-passport-sdk
scripts.demo: cd examples/example-app && node ../../packages/cli/dist/cli.js init --yes && node ../../packages/cli/dist/cli.js demo
